flow_summary: The system successfully completed the intake and managed the patient's disorganized responses by consistently re-prompting for specific formats. However, the interviewer was overly mechanical, often ignoring the patient's conversational cues and relying on rigid, repetitive prompts rather than natural redirection.

issues.evidence: The interviewer repeatedly used 'Please repeat your [data point]' as a standard response to any patient hesitation, rather than acknowledging the patient's confusion or clarifying the request.

When the patient disclosed, 'I’ve been really low and… just so tired all the time. Everything feels heavy, and I’m overwhelmed with the baby and my toddler,' the interviewer immediately pivoted to 'What do you hope to get out of your appointment?' without any acknowledgement of the distress.

In the family psychiatric history section, the interviewer asked 'Are there any other family members with a mental health condition?' twice in a row, despite the patient having already stated 'No, those are all' in the previous turn.
